speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, could you tell me if the double vision, weakness, or difficulty climbing stairs has changed in severity throughout the day? Also, have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or changes in your speech?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: The pattern of weakness worsening with activity and improving with rest, along with double vision, is highly suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder. To confirm this, I need to check for specific antibodies and nerve conduction abnormalities. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibody_test REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_nerve_stimulation
